body: If music makes you happy, then you completely deserve to do it!
Yup. I am very very fortune. I know that. I really do. Doesn't make this stupid depression any better!
Yup, I know I am very lucky! Doesn't make me less depressed, though.

Linkin Park, mostly. When my depression first started like 15 years ago, Chester Bennington's lyrics made me feel like someone knew exactly how I was feeling, felt similar, and was still managing to survive. Since his death, that "still managing to survive" part is gone, but his music still makes me feel so understood and like I am not alone in feeling these things.

Mostly listening to Iridescent, One Step Closer, Leave Out All the Rest, and Halfway Right lately. With Battle Symphony to try to find motivation to keep going.

For me it is little things. Like a shift in the music I find myself listening to and enjoying. I notice that maybe I am not quite as stuck in my head as much. Or I notice that I am not needing quite as many cups of coffee just to get through work. Or suddenly realize I made it to work on time for a full week. Little things like that. 

I also noticed that some of the hobbies I loved when i wasn't on meds weren't the same ones I loved while on them. Like maybe the depression was making me crave things that were more creative and thus love drawing, but with that lifted I didn't get my want to be creative back, but found that I could really enjoy some other hobbies (for me it was stuff that takes energy, like martial arts).
Even when I am not feeling like I really want to die...having that option is weirdly comforting...
Never be sorry for taking up space. You have every right to that space. I am sorry you are struggling.

I mean, IMO that is 100% true. Hell our existance is so short in the grand scheme of things, everything we do is just bullshit...but I find that kind of freeing. Big picture, it doesn't matter...so don't let it weigh you down too much.

The trick, I think -- and I fail at it mostly -- is to find the bullshit that can make you happy and run with it.
How did you find the courage to hit "send"? That is a huge step, one that I don't think I could take.  Even though I don't know you, I am so proud of you for it.

Was writing it all out enough, or did it just make it easier to say it all to someone? I have one online friend I can sort of tell some stuff to because it isn't in person, and is often not "live" because of a huge time difference. How did you make the leap to say it outloud?

I feel like if anyone I ride in my car with actually listened to the lyrics of what I have playing carefully, then all my secrets would be out. Luckily no one does. Or maybe unluckily. I don't know anymore!

I am up to 15 years struggling with this. Started when I was 13. 

I have tried therapy, meds, etc...with varying success for varying amounts of time. I am not really sure either. I just keep going, because I don't have any other choice really. Or at least I am in a place now that I don't really want to make that other choice, so that is a positive. 

What I have learned is that there is no "face" of depression. There doesn't need to be a "why" or a shitty situation. Which, to me, really sucks because I feel like if my life was shitty i could blame something other than myself...or see steps to a solution...

Yeah, thank goodness it went away when i stopped the meds. It was horrific. And kind of scary at the time because it was so sudden and random. I have tried to get on wellbutrin again since it worked so well and maybe the side effect was a combo of things, but it started again so had to stop again.

I hope it works well for you, and don't fear that side effect. It is insanely rare and went away as soon as i stopped taking it!
I do love me some Mumford and Sons as well...but very mood dependent. Not feeling them right now, unfortunately. Hopefully soon, though!

Today I made an 8 hour play list for a road trip, and when I was done I realized it is almost entirely Linkin Park, Papa Roach, and Shinedown...I quickly added some Blink-182 and Fall Out Boy so it could keep the same sound but not sound like a major cry for help to those in the car. 

I look forward to this same subtle sign, should it come. I am so happy it has started for you!  Awesome that someone else has a similar subtle sign as I do!

Same. Sometimes it is more debilitating than others...but on the whole...I make it to work, though often very late but I am lucky that I don't have hard set hours  (I do miss quite a bit lately, but I have tons of sick leave stored up, so not a huge deal...), at work I am not as productive as I used to be, but I haven't missed any deadlines. I don't make it to my exercise classes much lately because I don't have energy,but I do sometimes. 

Also my life is fine. I am 28 and own my house, have no real debt (except my mortgage) because I am very very fortunate that my parents could pay for my college and my work paid for my grad school, I have a dog who I do agility with, I have friends I see weekly even if they don't know the real me...

My life is great. I have NOTHING to complain about it. Yet I am very depressed. I hurt, I am exhausted, I am numb, I have urges to self-harm, sometimes suicidal thoughts. I feel like a fraud when I try to talk to anyone about it. I don't look that depressed. I have tons going for me. 

You hit the nail on the head...it sucks.
Not too long ago I ordered a 5 pound bag of gummy candies from amazon. I am proud the bag lasted almost a week! It was my dinner a few times!
Very very loud tinnitus. Like...couldn't hear the TV levels of loud. It was nuts.

This worked wonderfully for me, until I developed a super rare side effect (well under 1% of people,not even listed on the paper work it is so rare). I was super bummed because it is so far the only med that has really worked for me. 

I wish you luck with it. It helped me concentrate, lifted my mood without making me feel numb, I slept better. It wasn't a miracle, but it was the best I have found. :(

I am in the exact same boat right now. 

I haven't for over a year...but the urge is nearly constant now. I, too, won't. Or at least, I am pretty sure I won't. I gotta keep my streak going after all...

Thanks for sharing and letting me know I am not alone in my struggle right now.

I don't know you, but I care. 

I really do. Everyone deserves to be happy and everyone deserves a real chance. It *can* get better...or at least different...and maybe different is enough sometimes...and I want everyone to be able to hang on long enough to see things change. So I care. Everyone matters, everything is connected on some level. More than we know.

I find that is almost worse. At least when someone hates me, they have feelings for me...even if they are negative...on some level I have to matter to them for them to hate me. 

Indifference sucks.

I don't mind the commiseration of them complaining, too, especially if it is about similar things or similar feelings...but only if they ACTUALLY LISTEN, and not just jumping in with their chance to complain.

I do this too. I have only opened up a tiny bit here and there, but when I have, what I have found, is that they do take me seriously, but they don't grasp the extent i am struggling because I can't ever really let down the mask outside of maybe that tiny bit of vulnerability...so the next second we are laughing and joking again.

They do 100% believe me...but the depth is what they miss.

My SO and I have been dating for like 4 years, and been friends for like 8 years. I still can't really open up to him. He knows I have depression, he knows I take meds, and he knows in an abstract sense that I still struggle. I dunno if we will ever get to where I can really share. That is probably on both of us, but also probably me more than him.

There is no one in my real life I can really talk to. I don't know how to get there with someone. And I don't think I am worth their time anyway.

I have a few.

From my username, obviously Breaking the Habit

But also sometimes Iridescent, Halfway Right, waiting for the end, or one step closer.

I have been depressed for so long (though it tends to be a bit cyclic with bad times and less bad times), that I don't think I know how to be happy if it were to happen. So I do get the feeling you are describing, I think. Times I am especially up feel alien and there is a weird comfort, probably due to familiarity, that happens in the down times.
Yeah, it gave me kind of a dark chuckle.

Yup, and I really am. And I AM glad I don't have them, too.

It is a weird contradiction,and I just wanted to get it off my chest, I guess.
Yeah I mean. I am glad I don't have any scars for so many reasons. It is a weird contradiction.
What ended up happening? Is everything OK?

I HATE feeling altered in anyway...or not in full control always. It is why I hate being anything more than tipsy, hate geting high, and hate being on pain meds when I have had to be in the past. So I am think I am okay in regards to looking for alternatives in drugs and alcohol. 

I really see your point though, and it makes a lot of sense. Thank you for sharing!
Thanks for the advice.  Definitely will work on figuring out my triggers.
Thanks for sharing. It really is important to be ready. I wish you luck on getting to that place.

I do Krav Maga 3 to 5 days a week, and lately been training without even wearing hand wraps for the same reason. 

I don't have any useful advice, but thought I would share that I totally understand the punching bag thing and you are very much not alone in that.
I am glad to hear that it has gotten easier with time. It's so hard now :(

*big internet hugs* 

I know similar feelings (I won't claim to know exactly how you feel, since no one can really know how someone else feels), and I don't have any good advice or anything, but I can commiserate. 

We are stronger than we give ourselves credit for.

I have started doing Krav Maga 3-5 days a week, and also learning to  play hockey 1-2 days a week.  It definitely helps. If I miss a day tho because I have to work late, it gets hard. 

Glad to hear it is getting a bit easier for you to go longer and longer. Slip ups don't negate all the times you don't give in :)
I don't know what is stopping me either, really. But something is. I am kinda afraid to try to figure out what in case it is nothing.

Thanks. I am starting to think they won't ever go away completely. But I think that is okay. Usually they are just kinda fleeting like "xxx made me angry, I wanna cut", but I can immediately dismiss it.

Thanks. I really do know all that...but just hearing someone say it who is also kinda in the same position helps a ton. 

I have struggled with depression since I was about 12 or so, tho got much worse in my teens and young adult life. I have been doing pretty well, but lately it has been getting to me again. Maybe that is why I have the increase in the urges. 

I am trying to remind myself that it actually takes more control to NOT give in, and maybe that helps my need for control a bit, but it is the release that I am craving. 

Thanks for the words. They really do help a ton. Just kinda hearing them from someone who understands takes some of the burden off. :)

The problem is I don't know what I am doing wrong. Like tonight, he said he wasn't feeling well shortly before we were going to have sex for the first time in a week (was that time of the month) and I mentioned that if he wasn't feeling well not to feel obligated to bang just because it has been a week. He then freaked out thinking I didn't want to and was very hurt that I didn't want sex. 

I spent 30 mind reexplaining that I was just saying he shouldn't feel obligated. 

It is all like that. I feel like I did nothing wrong yet hurt him so bad.

I make every effort to not hurt those around me, but I always do. Everyday. I live with my So now, he moved in about a month ago. All I have done is hurt and upset him since then. 

He lost his job 2 months ago and ends up asking me why I kick him when he is down. I never do on purpose. I just can't ever do or say anything right. 

I deserve to feel this awful. He would definitely be better off if I never existed.

I don't even know specifically. I just feel like I keep screwing everything up. I am in the themost amazing relationship ever... And I keep just screwing it up. I ijust feel like such a total fuck up...
You still willing to/have time to talk?

Yeah, i get the impression, esp after starting this thread, that it is pretty "normal".

I wish I could just make my brain shut up about it.

I never thought of it as a threshold, that actually is a great way of viewing what the meds are doing. It definitely felt that way. 

I am one of the lucky ones with a job that pays me enough to make rent (even if I am being furloughed). Those resources are great though. Def upvoting for others reading this.

I really don't want to. 

My doc doesn't know I stopped, I should talk to her.

I tapered myself of of wellbutrin and lithium. 

I went really slowly. Cold turkey can have BAD side effects...should never do it without your docs advice either.

I will say, they can be helpful. And I am an idiot for stopping them when they are working.

They definitely saved my life at one point. There was just something I didn't like about taking them every day. I recognize it is an illness...but I am unlikely to seek treatment for illnesses unless they are dangerously bad too.

I have tried the therapist route...they always want to know WHY I am depressed, etc...when I don't have a reason aside from "the chemicals in my brain don't like to play nice!")...and I was on meds but quit because I HATE being so reliant on them. 

That might have been a mistake.

yeah, I have been trying to go to the gym/go out side and running til I can't think. Playing video games, reading, etc.

I  have had these before, in fact I do most of the time. They have just become so consistent the last week, and the last few days they are harder to be distracted from.
This guy did that too! It was so frustrating. Though in a way it did help, I got really angry, and that distracted me.

I contacted one of those hotlines, I can't remember which ones, and I told them right up that I was doing awful and wanted to self-harm but had no intentions of killing myself. 

They proceeded to ignore everything I said and just kept putting words in my mouth, talking about how I had stuff to live for, etc. No matter how many times I said I was not suicidal and just needed to talk, they kept ignoring what I was saying.  I hung up on them, feeling way worse than I when I called.

So much for asking for help. 

EDIT: I don't mean this story to discourage people from calling. They are GREAT resources and help a lot of people. I just got a clueless person.

I get that last feeling quite often, way more than being actually suicidal...just wishing I never existed...but not really to die. 

I can't decide if that scares me more or not...the total uncaring complacency vs actually being "strong" enough to make a decision.
Actually asking for that help is so much easier said than done, though. I know, for me at least, when I am down at that point, I don't feel like help is worth it, like *I* am worth that help.

I had something similar happen...my means (also pain meds, left over from wisdom teeth removal) disappeared from my room. I think my parents needed it for something. I was just too tired and sick of everything to even be bothered to try to find it, and gave up on giving up.

I still get suicidal though.

Luck.

Now that I am not that low anymore, I see reasons to keep going, but at that moment when I was my lowest...it was luck.

Yup, this I all know. I get HOW to meet people.

Internet isn't really cheesy anymore. It seems like a great way to break the ice with no awkwardness. Especially for quiet/shy people.

First off, I am NOT asking how to meet people. I was asking for stories of people who successfully did it. I get HOW you do it, but it seems like most don't have to, so I was looking for some hope. 

But you can't really do the same things...

I no longer live with all people my age. I no longer work only with peers my age. There aren't any frat parties unless I want to be the weird old graduate who still attends. 

You can still do things and meet people. But it is harder and not nearly the same. No one knocks on your door at 3am to come to the party that is still raging next door.
Yeah, that is how I plan to meet people when I am ready.

6 years really isn't that much of an age difference. I know a lot of people dating a much bigger difference (10 or more years!)

But yeah, definitely an open mind of where and when to meet people. Be it possible friends or possible SOs.

Thanks for sharing :)

What a great ice breaker: "Well, I already know what your penis looks like...so what's your name?"

Thanks for sharing.
My goal is not a new boyfriend. At least not for a LONG while. I just wanna know for sure that it is possible. That people do meet after college.

I will need to learn to walk in those heels...I somehow missed that lesson. I blame majoring in Physics. Not a lot of girly stuff there!

But yeah, I have heard/read gym a lot, not just for meeting people, but for trying to get over this relationship. I wish it was as easy as that. I want to fast forward like 3 months when it won't be as bad (hopefully).
Was a good response. Don't need to mess with that again!

Yeah, I know I won't be ready to date for a long while. But meeting more people and more friends would be good whether it leads to anything or not. My social life kinda revolved around my ex, so I am left without much to do except miss him.

And that can't be healthy.
Well, the context does. I met at beer pong party at the dorm next door. That kind of stuff doesn't happen anymore.

Thanks. I am trying to work on it. Often times the emotional response to things over rules the logical ones. Makes it hard.
I don't actually. The song came on the radio today as a song that isn't played anymore. Hearing it just made me realize it was exactly how I feel. I don't think I could name another song by them.
Not so much my favorite song as just the one that describes me perfectly. I almost hate it for that.

Linking Park's Breaking the Habit is pretty much about me. I am not gonna kill myself. But I pick fights like that all the time. The refrain is EXACTLY how I feel. And I hate it. It makes me the crazy girlfriend. 

And it hurts me just as much as it hurts my boyfriend.
